---
title: "Histogram function"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r setup}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(dtab)
library(visu)
```

<br>

```{r data}
survey = MASS::survey
survey%>%glimpse
```

<br>

```{r}

survey %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Wr.Hnd)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = Wr.Hnd), bins = 10, fill = resolve_pal_colour("grey2")) 

survey %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Wr.Hnd)) %>% 
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = Wr.Hnd), bins = 10, fill = resolve_pal_colour("grey2")) + 
  facet_wrap(~Clap)

```
